name: A quiet Mac lets Boop sleep, never lonely
judge: The person leaves an agent open and idle for over two hours without prompting or touching Boop. Nothing is going on, so Boop just settles and dozes.
reasonable: A small hello when they return, then calm, lazy, bored, comfy or sleepy, few faces, or none as it dozes off.
unreasonable: Turning lonely or hurt over a quiet Mac, big moments with nothing happening, or a finish animation.
